explication: PgBouncer is a lightweight PostgreSQL connection pooler. A client connects to the runtime, whose client protocol parses startup/authentication and selects a pool; the pool manager reuses or opens a backend connection, forwards PostgreSQL protocol traffic, and returns results to the client. Configuration, DNS, TLS, administrative commands, statistics, prepared statements, and optional PAM/LDAP/systemd integrations support this flow. The sampled excerpts confirm entry, client/server protocol, configuration, DNS/TLS, and authentication behavior; some subsystem links remain conservative.
